Marina Diamond 3 is a 15-storey mid-rise residential tower located in the vibrant waterfront community of Dubai Marina. Developed by Diamond Investments LLC (also known as Diamond Developers), the building commenced construction in 2005 and was completed in June 2007. It is part of the larger six-tower Marina Diamond complex and contains approximately 190 freehold residential units. 
Detailed overviews of the building's specifications, layout options, and primary amenities are listed below. 

Property Overview & Layouts Unit Types:
The building exclusively features freehold studio, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments. Studio Apartments: Sizes range from 427 sq. ft. to 450 sq. ft. , featuring an open-style kitchen, a single bathroom, and select units with private balconies Average around 1,009 sq. ft. and offer two bathrooms, a living area, a kitchen, and a balcony. 

Building Amenities & Lifestyle Fitness Options:
Residents have access to a fully equipped gymnasium, an outdoor swimming pool, and sauna facilities. On-Site Retail: The ground level houses a convenient retail area complete with a mini-mart, a laundry shop, a dental clinic, and multiple restaurants. 

Security & Concierge: Features 24-hour concierge services, central air-conditioning, and 24/7 security staff backed by integrated CCTV monitoring. 

Conveniences: Features secure covered parking, high-speed passenger elevators, an outdoor barbecue area, and landscaped gardens. 

Location & Connectivity Transit Access: Situated on Al Marsa Street with immediate access to Sheikh Zayed Road, making city commuting simple. It sits within short walking distance of both the Dubai Metro and Dubai Tram networks. 

Nearby Attractions: Positioned close to the luxury beach resort of Marina Walk, and a short drive to Marina Beach, JBR Walk, and major business hubs like Dubai Internet City and Dubai Media City.
